source: USCIS, Civics (History and Government) Questions for the Naturalization Test, 100 questions (rev. 01/19), uscis.gov
note: Questions and answers extracted by script from the official USCIS PDF downloaded from uscis.gov on 2026-11-11 (not re-typed). explain_so lines are the academy's own Somali teaching notes (not official text). 'changes' marks answers that depend on current office-holders or the learner's state (check uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates before an interview).

questions.q: What is the supreme law of the land?
questions.explain_so: Constitution-ku (dastuurka) waa sharciga ugu sarreeya dalka. Sharci kasta oo kale waa inuu isaga waafaqo.

questions.q: What does the Constitution do?
questions.explain_so: Constitution-ku wuxuu dhisaa dowladda, wuxuu qeexaa awoodaheeda, wuxuuna ilaaliyaa xuquuqda aasaasiga ah ee dadka. Hal mid sheeg.

questions.q: The idea of self-government is in the first three words of the Constitution. What are these words?
questions.explain_so: Saddexda eray ee ugu horreeya Constitution-ka waa “We the People” — annaga dadka ah. Dadka ayaa is xukuma.

questions.q: What is an amendment?
questions.explain_so: Amendment waa wax-ka-beddel ama kordhin lagu sameeyo Constitution-ka.

questions.q: What do we call the first ten amendments to the Constitution?
questions.explain_so: Tobanka amendment ee ugu horreeya waxaa la yiraahdaa Bill of Rights — xuquuqda aasaasiga ah.

questions.q: What is one right or freedom from the First Amendment?
questions.explain_so: First Amendment wuxuu ilaaliyaa xorriyadda hadalka, diinta, isu-imaatinka, saxaafadda iyo cabashada dowladda loo gudbiyo. Hal sheeg.

questions.q: How many amendments does the Constitution have?
questions.explain_so: Ilaa hadda Constitution-ka 27 jeer ayaa wax laga beddelay. Tirada xusuuso: twenty-seven.

questions.q: What did the Declaration of Independence do?
answers: said that the United States is free (from Great Britain)
questions.explain_so: Declaration of Independence waa qoraalkii lagu dhawaaqay in Maraykanku ka xoroobay Ingiriiska, in dadku siman yihiin, xuquuqna ku dhasheen.

questions.q: What are two rights in the Declaration of Independence?
questions.explain_so: Declaration of Independence waxay xustay saddex xuquuq: nolol, xorriyad iyo raadinta farxadda. Laba sheeg.

questions.q: What is freedom of religion?
answers: You can practice any religion, or not practice a religion.
questions.explain_so: Xorriyadda diintu waa: diinta aad doonto ayaad ku dhaqmi kartaa, cidina kaama hor istaagi karto.

questions.q: What is the economic system in the United States?
questions.explain_so: Dhaqaalaha Maraykanku waa capitalism: ganacsiga waxaa iska leh dadka iyo shirkadaha, suuquna waa xor.

questions.q: What is the “rule of law”?
answers: No one is above the law.
questions.explain_so: Rule of law waxay ka dhigan tahay: qofna sharciga kama sarreeyo. Madax, dowlad iyo shacabba waa inay sharciga raacaan.

questions.q: Name one branch or part of the government.
questions.explain_so: Saddexda laamood waa Congress (legislative), President (executive) iyo maxkamadaha (judicial). Hal sheeg.

questions.q: What stops one branch of government from becoming too powerful?
questions.explain_so: Dowladda waxaa loo qaybiyay saddex laamood si aan midkoodna u noqon mid awood xad-dhaaf ah leh — mid walba kuwa kale ayuu ilaaliyaa (checks and balances).

questions.q: Who is in charge of the executive branch?
questions.explain_so: Madaxweynuhu wuxuu hoggaamiyaa laanta fulinta — executive branch.

questions.q: Who makes federal laws?
questions.explain_so: Sharciyada federaalka waxaa qora Congress-ka, oo ah laanta sharci-dejinta.

questions.q: What are the two parts of the U.S. Congress?
questions.explain_so: Congress-ku wuxuu ka kooban yahay laba aqal: Senate iyo House of Representatives.

questions.q: How many U.S. Senators are there?
questions.explain_so: Waxaa jira 100 senator — gobol kasta laba.

questions.q: We elect a U.S. Senator for how many years?
questions.explain_so: Senator-ka waxaa loo doortaa lix sano markiiba.

questions.q: Who is one of your state’s U.S. Senators now?
answers: Answers will vary. [District of Columbia residents and residents of U.S. territories should answer that D.C. (or the territory where the applicant lives) has no U.S. Senators.]
questions.explain_so: Jawaabtu waxay ku xiran tahay gobolka aad deggan tahay. Baro magaca mid ka mid ah labada senator ee gobolkaaga, kana hubi senate.gov ka hor wareysiga.

questions.q: The House of Representatives has how many voting members?
questions.explain_so: House of Representatives wuxuu leeyahay 435 xubnood oo cod leh.

questions.q: We elect a U.S. Representative for how many years?
questions.explain_so: Xubinta House-ka waxaa loo doortaa laba sano markiiba.

questions.q: Name your U.S. Representative.
answers: Answers will vary. [Residents of territories with nonvoting Delegates or Resident Commissioners may provide the name of that Delegate or Commissioner. Also acceptable is any statement that the territory has no (voting) Representatives in Congress.]
questions.explain_so: Jawaabtu waxay ku xiran tahay degmada (district) aad ku nooshahay. Magaca wakiilkaaga ka raadi house.gov adigoo gelinaya ZIP code-kaaga.

questions.q: Who does a U.S. Senator represent?
questions.explain_so: Senator-ku wuxuu matalaa dhammaan dadka gobolkiisa.

questions.q: Why do some states have more Representatives than other states?
questions.explain_so: Gobolka dadkiisu bato ayaa hela representatives badan; tirada waxaa lagu saleeyaa tirada dadka.

questions.q: We elect a President for how many years?
questions.explain_so: Madaxweynaha waxaa loo doortaa afar sano.

questions.q: In what month do we vote for President?
questions.explain_so: Madaxweynaha waxaa la doortaa bisha November.

questions.q: What is the name of the President of the United States now?
answers: Visit uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates for the name of the President of the United States.
questions.explain_so: Sheeg magaca madaxweynaha hadda xilka haya. Doorasho ka dib wuu is beddeli karaa — ka hubi uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates.

questions.q: What is the name of the Vice President of the United States now?
answers: Visit uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates for the name of the Vice President of the United States.
questions.explain_so: Sheeg magaca madaxweyne-ku-xigeenka hadda xilka haya. Wuu is beddeli karaa — ka hubi uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates.

questions.q: If the President can no longer serve, who becomes President?
questions.explain_so: Haddii madaxweynuhu shaqada gudan kari waayo, madaxweyne-ku-xigeenka (Vice President) ayaa beddela.

questions.q: If both the President and the Vice President can no longer serve, who becomes President?
questions.explain_so: Haddii madaxweynaha iyo ku-xigeenkiisu labaduba shaqayn kari waayaan, waxaa madaxweyne noqda Speaker-ka House-ka.

questions.q: Who is the Commander in Chief of the military?
questions.explain_so: Commander in Chief waa taliyaha ugu sarreeya ciidamada — waa madaxweynaha.

questions.q: Who signs bills to become laws?
questions.explain_so: Bill waa sharci-qabyo. Marka madaxweynuhu saxiixo ayuu sharci noqdaa.

questions.q: Who vetoes bills?
questions.explain_so: Veto waa diidmo: madaxweynuhu wuu diidi karaa sharci-qabyo uu Congress-ku u soo gudbiyay.

questions.q: What does the President’s Cabinet do?
questions.explain_so: Cabinet-ku waa lataliyayaasha madaxweynaha — wasiirrada ayaa talo siiya.

questions.q: What are two Cabinet-level positions?
answers: Secretary of Health and Human Services
Secretary of Housing and Urban Development
questions.explain_so: Cabinet-ka waxaa ku jira wasiirro sida Secretary of State iyo Secretary of Defense. Laba xil sheeg.

questions.q: What does the judicial branch do?
answers: decides if a law goes against the Constitution
questions.explain_so: Laanta garsoorku waxay dib u eegtaa oo sharxdaa sharciyada, waxayna xallisaa khilaafaadka sharciga.

questions.q: What is the highest court in the United States?
questions.explain_so: Supreme Court waa maxkamadda ugu sarreysa dalka.

questions.q: How many justices are on the Supreme Court?
answers: Visit uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates for the number of justices on the Supreme Court.
questions.explain_so: Tirada garsoorayaasha Supreme Court ka hubi uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates ka hor wareysigaaga.

questions.q: Who is the Chief Justice of the United States now?
answers: Visit uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates for the name of the Chief Justice of the United States.
questions.explain_so: Chief Justice waa garsooraha ugu sarreeya Supreme Court. Magaca hadda ka hubi uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates.

questions.q: Under our Constitution, some powers belong to the federal government. What is one power of the federal government?
questions.explain_so: Awoodaha u gaarka ah dowladda federaalka waxaa ka mid ah daabacaadda lacagta, ku-dhawaaqista dagaalka iyo heshiisyada caalamiga ah.

questions.q: Under our Constitution, some powers belong to the states. What is one power of the states?
questions.explain_so: Gobolladu waxay bixiyaan waxbarashada, booliska, dab-damiska iyo liisanka darawalnimada. Hal mid sheeg.

questions.q: Who is the Governor of your state now?
answers: Answers will vary. [District of Columbia residents should answer that D.C. does not have a Governor.]
questions.explain_so: Sheeg magaca guddoomiyaha (governor) gobolka aad deggan tahay. Ka hubi bogga rasmiga ah ee gobolkaaga ka hor wareysiga.

questions.q: What is the capital of your state?
answers: Answers will vary. [District of Columbia residents should answer that D.C. is not a state and does not have a capital. Residents of U.S. territories should name the capital of the territory.]
questions.explain_so: Sheeg caasimadda gobolkaaga — tusaale, Minnesota waa Saint Paul, Ohio waa Columbus. Jawaabtu gobol walba way ku kala duwan tahay.

questions.q: What are the two major political parties in the United States?
questions.explain_so: Labada xisbi ee waaweyn waa Democratic iyo Republican.

questions.q: What is the political party of the President now?
answers: Visit uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates for the political party of the President.
questions.explain_so: Xisbiga madaxweynaha hadda xilka haya ka hubi uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates.

questions.q: What is the name of the Speaker of the House of Representatives now?
answers: Visit uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates for the name of the Speaker of the House of Representatives.
questions.explain_so: Speaker-ku waa guddoomiyaha House of Representatives. Magacu wuu is beddeli karaa — ka hubi uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates ka hor wareysigaaga.

questions.q: There are four amendments to the Constitution about who can vote. Describe one of them.
answers: You don’t have to pay (a poll tax) to vote.
Any citizen can vote. (Women and men can vote.)
A male citizen of any race (can vote).
questions.explain_so: Afar amendment ayaa ballaariyay xaqa codaynta: muwaadin kasta oo 18 jir ah ama ka weyn, rag iyo dumarba, wuu codayn karaa, lacagna lagama qaado. Hal mid sharax.

questions.q: What is one responsibility that is only for United States citizens?
questions.explain_so: Laba waajib oo muwaadiniinta u gaar ah: ka-qaybgalka jury iyo codaynta doorashada federaalka. Hal sheeg.

questions.q: Name one right only for United States citizens.
questions.explain_so: Laba xuquuq oo muwaadiniinta u gaar ah: codaynta doorashada federaalka iyo u-tartanka xil federaal. Hal sheeg.

questions.q: What are two rights of everyone living in the United States?
questions.explain_so: Qof kasta oo Maraykanka ku nool wuxuu leeyahay xorriyadda hadalka, diinta iyo isu-imaatinka. Laba sheeg.

questions.q: What do we show loyalty to when we say the Pledge of Allegiance?
questions.explain_so: Pledge of Allegiance waa ballanta daacadnimada: waxaan daacad u nahay Maraykanka iyo calankiisa.

questions.q: What is one promise you make when you become a United States citizen?
answers: give up loyalty to other countries
defend the Constitution and laws of the United States
obey the laws of the United States
serve in the U.S. military (if needed)
serve (do important work for) the nation (if needed)
be loyal to the United States
questions.explain_so: Dhaarta jinsiyadda waxaad ku ballanqaadaysaa inaad daacadnimada dal kale ka tagto, Constitution-ka difaacdo, sharcigana raacdo. Hal ballan sheeg.

questions.q: How old do citizens have to be to vote for President?
questions.explain_so: Muwaadinku waa inuu 18 jir yahay ama ka weyn yahay si uu madaxweyne u doorto.

questions.q: What are two ways that Americans can participate in their democracy?
answers: give an elected official your opinion on an issue
publicly support or oppose an issue or policy
questions.explain_so: Ka-qaybgalka bulshada: codee, xisbi ku biir, koox bulsho ka mid noqo, ama wakiilkaaga la xiriir. Laba tusaale sheeg.

questions.q: When is the last day you can send in federal income tax forms?
questions.explain_so: Maalinta ugu dambeysa ee foomamka canshuurta federaalka la gudbiyo waa April 15.

questions.q: When must all men register for the Selective Service?
questions.explain_so: Ragga oo dhan waa inay iska diiwaangeliyaan Selective Service marka ay 18 jirsadaan (18 ilaa 26).

questions.q: What is one reason colonists came to America?
questions.explain_so: Dadkii ugu horreeyay ee Yurub ka yimid (colonists) waxay raadinayeen xorriyad — gaar ahaan xorriyad diimeed — iyo fursad dhaqaale. Hal sabab sheeg.

questions.q: Who lived in America before the Europeans arrived?
questions.explain_so: Yurubiyaanka ka hor, dhulkan waxaa ku noolaa American Indians, oo sidoo kale loo yaqaan Native Americans.

questions.q: What group of people was taken to America and sold as slaves?
questions.explain_so: Dad Afrikaan ah ayaa xoog lagu keenay oo addoon ahaan loo iibiyay.

questions.q: Why did the colonists fight the British?
answers: because of high taxes (taxation without representation)
because the British army stayed in their houses (boarding, quartering)
questions.explain_so: Sababaha xornimada loogu dhawaaqay waxaa ka mid ah canshuur culus oo aan wakiil laga lahayn, iyo is-xukun la'aan. Hal sheeg.

questions.q: Who wrote the Declaration of Independence?
questions.explain_so: Thomas Jefferson ayaa qoray Declaration of Independence.

questions.q: When was the Declaration of Independence adopted?
questions.explain_so: Waxaa la ansixiyay July 4, 1776 — maalinta dhalashada Maraykanka.

questions.q: There were 13 original states. Name three.
questions.explain_so: Saddex iyo tobankii gobol ee ugu horreeyay waxay ku yaalleen xeebta bari. Saddex sheeg — tusaale: New York, Virginia iyo Georgia.

questions.q: What happened at the Constitutional Convention?
answers: The Founding Fathers wrote the Constitution.
questions.explain_so: Shirkii Constitutional Convention waxaa lagu qoray Constitution-ka.

questions.q: When was the Constitution written?
questions.explain_so: Constitution-ka waxaa la qoray 1787.

questions.q: The Federalist Papers supported the passage of the U.S. Constitution. Name one of the writers.
questions.explain_so: Federalist Papers waa maqaallo taageeray Constitution-ka. Waxaa qoray Madison, Hamilton iyo Jay. Hal qoraa sheeg.

questions.q: What is one thing Benjamin Franklin is famous for?
answers: oldest member of the Constitutional Convention
first Postmaster General of the United States
questions.explain_so: Benjamin Franklin wuxuu ahaa diblomaasi iyo hal-abuure, wuxuuna aasaasay maktabadihii bilaashka ahaa ee ugu horreeyay. Hal sheeg.

questions.q: Who is the “Father of Our Country”?
questions.explain_so: George Washington waa “Father of Our Country” — aabbaha dalka — iyo madaxweynihii ugu horreeyay.

questions.q: Who was the first President?
questions.explain_so: George Washington waa “Father of Our Country” — aabbaha dalka — iyo madaxweynihii ugu horreeyay.

questions.q: What territory did the United States buy from France in 1803?
questions.explain_so: Sannadkii 1803 Maraykanku wuxuu Faransiiska ka iibsaday dhulka Louisiana, taasoo dalka laba jibbaartay.

questions.q: Name one war fought by the United States in the 1800s.
questions.explain_so: Dagaalladii qarnigii 19aad waxaa ka mid ah War of 1812 iyo Civil War. Hal sheeg.

questions.q: Name the U.S. war between the North and the South.
questions.explain_so: Dagaalkii sokeeye ee Waqooyi iyo Koonfur dhex maray waxaa la yiraahdaa Civil War.

questions.q: Name one problem that led to the Civil War.
questions.explain_so: Sababaha Civil War keenay waxaa ka mid ahaa addoonsiga, dhaqaalaha iyo xuquuqda gobollada. Hal sheeg.

questions.q: What was one important thing that Abraham Lincoln did?
answers: led the United States during the Civil War
questions.explain_so: Abraham Lincoln wuxuu xoreeyay addoommadii, wuxuuna midnimada dalka badbaadiyay xilligii Civil War. Hal sheeg.

questions.q: What did the Emancipation Proclamation do?
answers: freed slaves in the Confederate states
freed slaves in most Southern states
questions.explain_so: Emancipation Proclamation waa ku-dhawaaqistii Lincoln ee lagu xoreeyay addoommadii gobollada Koonfureed.

questions.q: What did Susan B. Anthony do?
questions.explain_so: Susan B. Anthony waxay u halgantay xuquuqda haweenka iyo xuquuqda madaniga.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Name one war fought by the United States in the 1900s.
questions.explain_so: Dagaalladii qarnigii 20aad: World War I, World War II, Korea, Vietnam iyo Gulf War. Hal sheeg.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Who was President during World War I?
questions.explain_so: Woodrow Wilson ayaa madaxweyne ahaa xilligii World War I.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Who was President during the Great Depression and World War II?
questions.explain_so: Franklin Roosevelt ayaa madaxweyne ahaa xilligii Great Depression iyo World War II.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Who did the United States fight in World War II?
questions.explain_so: World War II Maraykanku wuxuu la dagaallamay Japan, Jarmal iyo Talyaani.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Before he was President, Eisenhower was a general. What war was he in?
questions.explain_so: Eisenhower wuxuu jeneraal ka ahaa World War II ka hor intuusan madaxweyne noqon.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: During the Cold War, what was the main concern of the United States?
questions.explain_so: Walaaca ugu weyn wuxuu ahaa faafidda shuuciyadda (communism) iyo dagaal nukliyeer ah. Hal sheeg.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: What movement tried to end racial discrimination?
questions.explain_so: Dhaqdhaqaaqii xuquuqda madaniga (civil rights movement) wuxuu u halgamay in la joojiyo takoorka midabka.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: What did Martin Luther King, Jr. do?
answers: worked for equality for all Americans
questions.explain_so: Martin Luther King, Jr. wuxuu si nabad ah ugu halgamay xuquuqda madaniga iyo sinnaanta dadka oo dhan.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: What major event happened on September 11, 2001, in the United States?
questions.explain_so: September 11, 2001, argagixiso ayaa weerartay Maraykanka; kumannaan qof ayaa ku dhintay.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Name one American Indian tribe in the United States. [USCIS Officers will be supplied with a list of federally recognized American Indian tribes.]
questions.explain_so: Qabaa'ilka dadka asaliga ah waxaa ka mid ah Cherokee, Navajo iyo Sioux. Hal sheeg.

questions.q: Name one of the two longest rivers in the United States.
questions.explain_so: Labada webi ee ugu dhaadheer Maraykanka waa Missouri iyo Mississippi. Hal sheeg.

questions.q: What ocean is on the West Coast of the United States?
questions.explain_so: Xeebta galbeed waxaa ku taal badweynta Pacific.

questions.q: What ocean is on the East Coast of the United States?
questions.explain_so: Xeebta bari waxaa ku taal badweynta Atlantic.

questions.q: Name one U.S. territory.
questions.explain_so: Dhulalka Maraykanku maamulo (territories) waxaa ka mid ah Puerto Rico iyo Guam. Hal sheeg.

questions.q: Name one state that borders Canada.
questions.explain_so: Gobollada Canada xuduud la leh waxaa ka mid ah Minnesota, Washington, New York iyo Maine. Hal sheeg.

questions.q: Name one state that borders Mexico.
questions.explain_so: Gobollada Mexico xuduud la leh waa California, Arizona, New Mexico iyo Texas. Hal sheeg.

questions.q: What is the capital of the United States?
questions.explain_so: Caasimadda dalku waa Washington, D.C.

questions.q: Where is the Statue of Liberty?
answers: Liberty Island [Also acceptable are New Jersey, near New York City, and on the Hudson (River).]
questions.explain_so: Statue of Liberty — taallada xorriyadda — waxay ku taallaa dekedda New York.

questions.q: Why does the flag have 13 stripes?
answers: because the stripes represent the original colonies
questions.explain_so: Calanka 13-kiisa xariijimood waxay u taagan yihiin 13-kii gumeysi ee asalka ahaa.

questions.q: Why does the flag have 50 stars?
answers: because there is one star for each state
because each star represents a state
questions.explain_so: 50-ka xiddigood waxay u taagan yihiin 50-ka gobol.

questions.q: What is the name of the national anthem?
questions.explain_so: Heesta qaranka waxaa la yiraahdaa The Star-Spangled Banner.

questions.q: When do we celebrate Independence Day?
questions.explain_so: Independence Day waxaa la xusaa July 4.

questions.q: Name two national U.S. holidays.
questions.explain_so: Ciidaha qaranka waxaa ka mid ah New Year’s Day, Independence Day iyo Thanksgiving. Laba sheeg.
